messages:
Ivy (SE): Quick — AcmeFinancial POC tomorrow. Requirements: single gRPC connection with multiplexed user sessions from our Rust SDK, strict JSON-only outputs for downstream ledger reconciler, and minimal log retention. Any quick config recommendations?

Carlos (Solutions): Use function-calling with a tight JSON schema and temp=0. On the client add a small validator and request a replay if JSON invalid.

Evan (Runtime): For multiplexing add x-session-id header per chat. Set max_inflight=6 and enable per-session KV prefixing to avoid cache bleed.

Ivy (SE): They’ll stream long statements (~8k tokens). Backpressure risk?

Evan (Runtime): Summarize prior history client-side, enable prefix_kv_cache for system prompts, and watch server inflight queues. If tails show latency, reduce max_batch_tokens.

Rina (AE): Pricing: steady 300 concurrent sessions => recommend Dedicated reserved for unit cost and SLOs. I’ll draft a ballpark.

Ivy (SE): Security Q: retention/how to answer briefly?

sec-bot: Presales answer: default transient logs retained 30 days; Private deployments support customer-managed KMS; opt-out/reduced retention available for sensitive POCs. Escalate full questionnaire to Security.

Carlos (Solutions): For demo snippet (Rust): set headers x-tenant,x-session-id; max_inflight=6; on_chunk validate JSON schema and call replay endpoint if invalid.

Ivy (SE): Great — I'll run a 20-session canary before the call. Rina please join for pricing. Thanks :thumbsup:
